d: Fanatics Momentum is building the UAE's leading regulated commercial gaming operator. Licensed by the General Commercial Gaming Regulatory Authority (GCGRA), we operate across lottery, iGaming, sportsbook, and digital content, combining Momentum's regional foundation with Fanatics' global product, technology, and scale. The business is ambitious, well-resourced, and moving fast. If you want to help build a category-defining operator in one of the world's most exciting regulated gaming markets, this is the right time to join.

The Customer Service Agent will be the first point of contact for our players, providing high-quality assistance and resolving queries related to our online gaming platforms, including account issues, bonuses, deposits/withdrawals, and gameplay inquiries. The role is key in delivering a superior customer experience in line with company values, ensuring players are informed, engaged, and satisfied with their gaming experience.
q: Previous experience in a customer support role, ideally within the iGaming/Lottery, tech.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Arabic.
Familiarity with online casino/lottery and/or sportsbook platforms and terminology.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Comfortable working in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment.
Tech-savvy with the ability to quickly learn and navigate multiple systems (CRM tools, chat platforms, back-office systems).
Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
Rotational shift patterns (including weekends and public holidays)

At Fanatics Momentum, we’re proud to be a fair, transparent, and inclusive employer. We value diversity, collaboration, and innovation, and we’re committed to creating an environment where every team member can thrive. If you’re ready to grow your career and help us build Momentum, we’d love to hear from you.
r: Provide real-time support to players via live chat, email, and occasionally by phone in a fast-paced, 24/7 environment.
Handle queries related to registration, account verification (KYC), responsible gaming, transactions, game rules, and promotions.
Guide players through troubleshooting steps for technical issues (login problems, game performance, etc.).
Monitor and escalate suspicious or fraudulent activity according to internal procedures and regulatory guidelines.
Collaborate with internal departments to resolve complex issues.
Stay informed of the latest platform features, games, promotional offers, and industry regulations.
Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and follow up on open issues to ensure resolution.
Meet performance KPIs such as response time, resolution rate, and customer satisfaction scores (CSAT).
Contribute to the development of FAQs and knowledge base content.

d: Delivering exceptional value to high-net-worth clients, this role orchestrates the end-to-end management of priority banking relationships, ensuring tailored financial solutions that drive customer loyalty and business growth. Leveraging deep product knowledge and sound judgement, the role resolves complex client needs within policy and regulatory frameworks, balancing risk with opportunity.
q: Experience in Priority Banking or Private Banking relationship management.
r: Acquire new to bank HNI (High Network Individual) customer relationships satisfying the priority banking criteria through sales of liability, Asset and investment products.
To ensure cross sell and refer business to other areas of the bank (e.g. Business Banking, Corporate Banking etc.)
To be conversant with the full range of PRB Banking products and services
Meet all the assigned targets on WM revenue, FX revenue, Deposits and Assets consistently month on month.
Ensure that no mis-selling is made to the customer and the customer is made aware of all the risks, rewards, fees and charges of the products before execution of any deal.
Ensure that the NPS (Net promotor) score is higher than 50 at all times.
95% of the complaints and SRs (Service Requests) are resolved within the agreed TATs.
To be fully aware of all policies relating to operational risk, sales processes, credit policy, anti-mis-selling, etc.
To be responsible for ensuring up-to-date compliance, KYC and profiling for each client as well as maintaining a high level of confidentiality at all times.
To be responsible for assessing customer risk, suitability of products and explaining appropriate products and services to meet client requirements.
